tasks.description:
Create scripts/scs001/gate-check-cron.ts. Reads workspace/gates/phase1-5-gate.json. If file does not exist, logs 'gate file not found, skipping' and exits 0. Formats a Telegram message: '📊 Phase 1.5 Gate — <date>
Posts: X/30 | Views: X | Days left: X
Status: <status>
Recommendation: <recommendation>'. Sends via TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN + OWNER_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID using https.request. Use only stdlib (fs, path, https). No external npm deps. Under 80 lines.
